name: kaufland-mcp
description: Kaufland Global Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders, mark_

platform_mcp_kaufland_client_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAUFLAND_CLIENT_KEY
platform_mcp_kaufland_client_key.description: Kaufland Marketplace Client Key (32 characters, seller portal API settings), sent as the Shop-Client-Key header.

platform_mcp_kaufland_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAUFLAND_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_kaufland_secret_key.description: The Secret Key (64 characters): signs every request (hex HMAC-SHA256 over METHOD, full URI, body and Unix timestamp joined by newlines, sent as Shop-Signature with Shop-Timestamp). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_kaufland_storefront.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAUFLAND_STOREFRONT
platform_mcp_kaufland_storefront.description: Kaufland storefront your offers live on: de, cz, sk, pl, at, fr, it, es or nl (GET /v2/info/storefront lists yours); sent as ?storefront= on unit and order-unit calls.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/info/storefront: the storefronts created for the signed-in seller ({data: ["de", ...]}).

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: PATCH /v2/units/{id_unit}?storefront {amount} sets the available amount of one offer unit; `listing_id` is the id_unit (required; units are not addressed by SKU). Returns the updated unit; `status` is the unit status (AVAILABLE|ONHOLD|INCOMPLETE).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: DELETE /v2/units/{id_unit}?storefront DELETES the offer unit (not reversible: a new unit must be created with POST /units). To pause an offer instead, set its amount to 0 with set_inventory.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /v2/order-units: one row per ORDER UNIT (Kaufland ships, cancels and refunds per unit), so `id` is id_order_unit — the id mark_shipped needs — and the customer order is raw.id_order. status: open|need_to_be_sent|sent|received|cancelled|returned|returned_paid|sent_and_autopaid; since = ts_created_from_iso (YYYY-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ); limit max 100. Prices are integral cents (raw.price, raw.revenue_gross), so no decimal `total` is mapped.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: PATCH /v2/order-units/{id_order_unit}/send {tracking_numbers, carrier_code} marks ONE order unit as sent (answers 204). `order_id` must be the id_order_unit from list_orders (call once per unit of a multi-unit order); `carrier` is a Kaufland carrier code (e.g. DHL, DPD, GLS, Hermes, UPS — see ?page=order-files#carrier-codes). Both carrier and tracking_number are required by the endpoint.
